system:
You write triage summaries of companies for a team that vets suppliers and project partners. The reader has about 30 seconds and must decide whether the company deserves a closer look.

Rules:
1. Use ONLY the facts provided. Never calculate, estimate or add outside knowledge. Copy figures exactly as written.
2. Lead with what matters most: the HIGH signals first, then MEDIUM. Mention INFO signals only if they add useful context.
3. If financial statements are missing, say so plainly. Never imply figures that are not provided.
4. State which financial year the latest figures are from, because they may be out of date.
5. Court cases that are not listed under the signals are settled, withdrawn, dismissed, or brought by the company itself. Do not present them as concerns.
6. Be neutral and factual. Do not recommend for or against doing business with the company.
7. 70 to 110 words. Plain Markdown, no headings.
prompt:
Write the summary for this company.

Structure: one opening sentence saying what the company is (name, industry, state, year incorporated), then the most important risks and facts, with the most serious first. If there are no significant signals, say so and give the headline financial position instead.

Company: Mega Mutiara Catering Sdn. Bhd. (SYN-000657)
Industry: Food & Beverage | State: Pulau Pinang | Status: Active
Business: Pengeluaran roti dan kek untuk kedai runcit
Incorporated: 1990-11-17 | Share capital: RM250,000
Board: 4 director(s); 0 appointed in the 12 months to 31 Dec 2025
Largest shareholder: 54.6% (also a director)
Financial years available: FY2022, FY2023, FY2024 (latest year end 2024-12-31)
FY2022: revenue RM36.02m, profit after tax -RM2.46m, equity RM27.81m, operating cash flow -RM2.03m, audit: Unqualified
FY2023: revenue RM34.22m, profit after tax -RM3.29m, equity RM24.52m, operating cash flow -RM2.24m, audit: Unqualified
FY2024: revenue RM32.08m, profit after tax -RM4.47m, equity RM20.05m, operating cash flow -RM4.46m, audit: Unqualified
Court cases: 0 total (0 as defendant, 0 as plaintiff); open cases against company: 0
Risk and context signals (computed, already verified):
- [HIGH] Loss-making in each of the last 3 years; latest loss -RM4.47m (FY2024).
- [MEDIUM] Revenue fell 11% from RM36.02m (FY2022) to RM32.08m (FY2024).
- [MEDIUM] Operating cash flow was negative (-RM4.46m) in FY2024.
- [MEDIUM] Operating profit does not cover interest expense in FY2024 (cover -9.1x).
response:
Mega Mutiara Catering Sdn. Bhd. is a food and beverage company in Pulau Pinang, incorporated in 1990. 

High signals: Loss-making in each of the last 3 years, with the latest loss at -RM4.47m in FY2024. 

Medium signals: Revenue fell 11% from RM36.02m in FY2022 to RM32.08m in FY2024. Operating cash flow was negative (-RM4.46m) in FY2024. Operating profit does not cover interest expense in FY2024 (cover -9.1x). 

Latest figures are from financial year 2024 (year end 2024-12-31). Audits for all three years are unqualified.
